active_development_matrix: Linux Playwright patched Firefox 153.0 development build

obligations.environment: representative physical Android phone and tablet with governed Chrome build
obligations.missing_capability: No Android device, device lab, governed browser build, or authorized automation endpoint is available.
required_evidence: memory, lifecycle cleanup, long tasks, thermal and power observations
obligations.reactivation: BH-22 or earlier when representative Android infrastructure becomes available
obligations.substitution_rule: Desktop emulation and Linux Chromium do not close physical Android evidence.

obligations.environment: representative iPhone and iPad with governed iOS/iPadOS Safari builds
obligations.missing_capability: No Apple hardware, Xcode simulator host, Mobile Safari build, or authorized automation endpoint is available.
required_evidence: exact device, operating-system, and Safari fingerprint
memory, background/foreground, cleanup, long tasks, thermal and power observations
obligations.reactivation: BH-22 or earlier when representative Apple mobile infrastructure becomes available
obligations.substitution_rule: Linux WebKit builds, desktop emulation, and responsive viewport tests do not constitute iOS or iPadOS Safari evidence.

obligations.missing_capability: No macOS host or Safari automation endpoint is available.
obligations.reactivation: BH-22 or earlier when a governed macOS host becomes available
obligations.substitution_rule: A Linux WebKit build is engine-development evidence only and cannot substitute for Safari.

obligations.reactivation: BH-22 or earlier when a governed Windows host becomes available
obligations.substitution_rule: Linux browser evidence does not qualify Windows browser behavior or performance.

obligations.environment: second clean controlled Linux execution context
obligations.missing_capability: Only one Linux development machine is currently available.
required_evidence: repeat subset with independent host fingerprint
compare profile identity, medians, p95, variance, errors, and resource convergence
obligations.reactivation: BH-22 or earlier when a second controlled Linux context becomes available
obligations.substitution_rule: Repeated runs on the same host do not constitute cross-machine comparison.

obligations.environment: required browser, assistive-technology, touch, and physical-keyboard pairings
obligations.missing_capability: The required assistive technologies, devices, and trained manual review contexts are unavailable.
obligations.reactivation: BH-22 or earlier when governed pairings and reviewers become available
